tasks.title: docker-compose.dev.yml + Makefile targets + helper scripts
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/012-developer-onboarding-make-dev/{requirements.md, design.md}. SECOND: create docker-compose.dev.yml per design.md with meshsat-hub + mosquitto services + meshsat-dev-data named volume + optional tak-server profile. (REQ-1100..1107, REQ-1112) extend Makefile with `dev`, `dev-down`, `dev-clean`, `dev-logs`, `dev-shell` targets. (REQ-1104) `dev` target prereq-checks `docker compose version`. (REQ-1108) all env vars set per design. (REQ-1111) named volume mount. (REQ-1115) verify completion within 60s on the build host. Create scripts/dev-wait-for-hub.sh (polls /healthz) + scripts/dev-seed-simulators.sh (POSTs 3 simulators).
tasks.acceptance_test: make dev && curl -fsS http://localhost:6070/healthz && make dev-down

tasks.title: Auto-seed dev-tenant + default routes + no-op gateway modes + docs page
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/012-developer-onboarding-make-dev/{requirements.md, design.md}. SECOND: extend cmd/meshsat-hub/main.go so when HUB_MODE=standalone AND env HUB_DEV_AUTO_SEED=true (default true in dev compose), the Hub seeds a `dev-tenant` tenant + calls routing.SeedDefaults(ctx, "dev-tenant", "system:dev-bootstrap") on startup per spec/007 REQ-600. (REQ-1114) write docs/dev-onboarding.md with usage, troubleshooting, URL list (Hub UI, Mosquitto, optional TAK), known issues.
